Wan2.2 I2V 工作流程，具有自动参考图像分辨率调整和 LORA 堆栈加载器

重新设计了基本的 Wan2.2 图像到视频工作流程，以支持自动调整参考图像大小到所需的分辨率，以及适用于高噪声和低噪声模型的 LORA 堆栈加载器。

工作流程注释中提供了模型权重和链接。

Wan2.2 I2V workflow with auto reference image resolution adjustment and LORA stack loaders

The basic Wan2.2 Image to Video workflow redone to support automatic reference image resizing to desired resolution as well as LORA stack loaders for both high noise and low noise models.

The model weights and links are provided in the workflow notes.
